$comment: Manufacturer-specific DTC descriptions (P1xxx, P30-P33xx, B1/B2, C1/C2, U1/U2), per make. These meanings differ between makes, so a code is only described when this file has an entry for the vehicle's make; otherwise the app says the meaning is manufacturer-specific and not in the local database. Entries are added ONLY with tools/import_oem_dtcs.py from a source the project is licensed to use (source + license are recorded per profile). Nothing here is guessed or machine-translated; profiles with "verified": false are community-compiled data shown with an 'unverified' note. Third-party licences: see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
